segments.headline: Sensex ends 989 points down · Sebi studies Tata Steel deal
segments.cap: The Sensex lost 989 points today. And a ₹28,000 crore Tata deal is under Sebi's watch.
segments.tts: [excited] The Sensex lost nine hundred eighty-nine points today. And a twenty-eight thousand crore rupees Tata deal is under Sebi's watch.

segments.headline: Sensex ends 989 points down
segments.cap: The Sensex closed 989 points lower. The Nifty ended near 25,600. Traders booked profits after a two-day rally. Information technology shares fell the most. Rising oil prices, a weaker rupee and doubts over the India-US trade deal also weighed.
segments.tts: [excited] The Sensex closed nine hundred eighty-nine points lower. The Nifty ended near twenty-five thousand six hundred. Traders booked profits after a two-day rally. Information technology shares fell the most. Rising oil prices, a weaker rupee and doubts over the India-US trade deal also weighed.

head: SENSEX SINKS
989 POINTS
beats.note: Both indices ended in the red after *two days of gains*, with the Nifty finishing *near 25,600.*

head: PROFIT
BOOKING
beats.note: Traders *cashed in gains* after the rally, and *IT shares* took the biggest hit.

head: THREE
PRESSURES
beats.note: *Costlier oil*, a *weaker rupee* and an *unsettled trade deal* kept sentiment cautious.

segments.headline: Sebi studies Tata Steel deal
segments.cap: Sebi is studying the Tata Steel and APL Apollo deal. It is weighing whether to judge all parts of the deal together. APL Apollo would buy Tata Steel's tubes businesses for ₹28,000 crore, funded by borrowing. Minority shareholders are worried about that debt. APL Apollo shares rebounded about 4% in early trade after a sharp fall.
segments.tts: [excited] Sebi is studying the Tata Steel and APL Apollo deal. It is weighing whether to judge all parts of the deal together. APL Apollo would buy Tata Steel's tubes businesses for twenty-eight thousand crore rupees, funded by borrowing. Minority shareholders are worried about that debt. APL Apollo shares rebounded about four percent in early trade after a sharp fall.

head: IS SEBI
WATCHING?
beats.note: The regulator is checking whether *every part* of the deal should be *judged together.*

head: ₹28,000 CR
ON BORROWING
beats.note: APL Apollo pays for Tata Steel's tubes and colour-coated steel units with *borrowed money.*

head: DEBT
WORRY
beats.note: Smaller investors fear APL Apollo will carry *a heavy debt load* and say their *interests need safeguards.*

head: SHARES
BOUNCE 4%
beats.note: The stock *rose about 4%* in early trade, following a *steep drop* earlier this week.

segments.headline: Tata Sons fight hits court
segments.cap: The Tata Sons power struggle has reached court. Two trusts that control Tata Sons asked the Mumbai High Court to declare the reappointment of chairman N. Chandrasekaran invalid. Tata Trusts holds 66% of Tata Sons. The Tata Sons board backs a possible stock market listing, but the charity arm does not.
segments.tts: [excited] The Tata Sons power struggle has reached court. Two trusts that control Tata Sons asked the Mumbai High Court to declare the reappointment of chairman N. Chandrasekaran invalid. Tata Trusts holds sixty-six percent of Tata Sons. The Tata Sons board backs a possible stock market listing, but the charity arm does not.

head: TATA VS
TATA?
beats.note: The group's *controlling trusts* and its *board* disagree, so the fight went to court.

head: REAPPOINTMENT
CHALLENGED
beats.note: The trusts want the court to call the chairman's *reappointment invalid.*

head: 66% STAKE
IN TATA SONS
beats.note: The trusts hold *the biggest stake*, which is why their view matters so much.

segments.headline: Rupee slips as oil climbs
segments.cap: The rupee slipped 24 paise to 92.62 per dollar in early trade. Oil prices rose above $95 a barrel after vessels were reportedly targeted near the Strait of Hormuz. Steady foreign fund inflows and a softer dollar limited the fall.
segments.tts: [excited] The rupee slipped twenty-four paise to ninety-two point six two per dollar in early trade. Oil prices rose above ninety-five dollars a barrel after vessels were reportedly targeted near the Strait of Hormuz. Steady foreign fund inflows and a softer dollar limited the fall.

head: RUPEE
SLIPS 24 PAISE
beats.note: The currency weakened to *₹92.62 per dollar* as oil prices recovered.

head: OIL ABOVE
$95 A BARREL
beats.note: Reports of *vessels being targeted* near the Strait of Hormuz raised *supply worries.*

head: WHAT
LIMITED IT
beats.note: *Foreign fund inflows* and a *softer dollar* kept the fall small.

segments.headline: Mahanadi lists below IPO price
segments.cap: Mahanadi Coalfields, a Coal India unit, listed at a 2% discount to its ₹136 issue price. The ₹8,981 crore IPO was subscribed only 1.52 times. All the shares on sale came from Coal India, the parent.
segments.tts: [excited] Mahanadi Coalfields, a Coal India unit, listed at a two percent discount to its one hundred thirty-six rupees issue price. The eight thousand nine hundred eighty-one crore rupees IPO was subscribed only one point five two times. All the shares on sale came from Coal India, the parent.

head: A QUIET
DEBUT
beats.note: The shares started trading *about 2% below* the *₹136 issue price.*

head: IPO DEMAND
WAS MODEST
beats.note: Bids covered the shares on offer just *1.52 times* on a *₹8,981 crore* issue.

head: COAL INDIA
SELLS STAKE
beats.note: The parent, *Coal India*, was the *seller* of every share in this issue.
